scientific_integrity.limitations: Fixed real 0<=beta<2. Boundary cutoff convergence is not an absolute integral for beta>=1. No assertion about other renormalizations, higher dimensions or optimal O(L) errors.
scientific_integrity.method: An explicit radial-cutoff sesquilinear form and analytic Bessel-transform proof; finite checker is supplementary.
scientific_integrity.normalization: Unweighted analytic disk Bergman space with normalized area dA/pi; monomials sqrt(n+1) z^n.
scientific_integrity.priority_uncertainty: Closely related boundary-oscillation examples predate this calculation. No inspected result supplies the two-term signed counting law, but equivalent prior formulations remain possible.

title: Signed log-square spectral laws for boundary-chirp Bergman forms
